issue.title: gateway/antigravity: `items` 为 oneOf/anyOf 联合类型（无 type）时 Gemini 400 —— plainSchema 未兜底 items
issue.body:
## 概述

Codex 经 magpie 转发到 Antigravity（`gemini-3.8-flash`）时，只要 MCP 工具的参数里有 **`items` 是 `oneOf` / `anyOf` 联合类型（无 `type` 字段）**，Antigravity 就返回 400，整个回合失败。

同一个工具集走 OpenAI 兼容 / DeepSeek / GPT 等上游都正常，只有 Antigravity 拒绝。

## 报错

```text
400: Antigravity: * GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[67].parameters.properties[functions].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[68].parameters.properties[reviewed_obligations].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[70].parameters.properties[secrets].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[70].parameters.properties[actions].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[81].parameters.properties[left_native_observations].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[81].parameters.properties[right_native_observations].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[92].parameters.properties[static_comparisons].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[92].parameters.properties[runtime_comparisons].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[92].parameters.properties[mappings].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[109].parameters.properties[comparisons].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[122].parameters.properties[notes].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[122].parameters.properties[methods].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[211].parameters.properties[inventory_evidence].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[212].parameters.properties[inventory_evidence].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[213].parameters.properties[inventory_evidence].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[222].parameters.properties[static_layers].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[222].parameters.properties[runtime_observations].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[247].parameters.properties[native_observations].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[260].parameters.properties[native_observations].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
```

确定性失败：同一回合里每次重试都是同样的 400，不是账号或配额问题。

## 环境

- 客户端：Codex Desktop，agent `codex`
- 路由：Codex → magpie gateway → Antigravity（`gemini-3.8-flash`，effort high）
- magpie：`0.1.1306`（Windows），升级后 `0.1.1308` 现象相同
- 观测时间：2026-10-21 17:07 起
- MCP server：REA（逆向工程工具集，`mcp__rea__*`，共 309 个工具）
- 失败回合：24-27、33-80，共 54 次连续失败

## 最小 schema 形态

`mcp__rea__build_call_path` 的 `functions` 参数：

```json
{
  "functions": {
    "minItems": 1,
    "type": "array",
    "items": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "subject": {
          "anyOf": [
            { "oneOf": [ { "type": "object", "properties": { ... } } ] },
            { "type": "string" }
          ]
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

`mcp__rea__capture_browser_scenario` 的 `actions` 参数：

```json
{
  "actions": {
    "minItems": 1,
    "type": "array",
    "items": {
      "oneOf": [
        { "type": "object", "properties": { "step_id": {...}, "kind": {...} }, "required": [...] },
        { "type": "object", "properties": { ... } }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

关键：**`items` 本身没有 `type` 字段，只有 `oneOf` / `anyOf`。**

## 根因

`plainSchema()`（`internal/gateway/codeassist.go`）把 schema 裁到 Antigravity 接受的 OpenAPI 子集时，会丢掉 `oneOf` / `anyOf`，但**保留了外层的 `type: "array"` 和 `items`**。

结果发出的是：

```json
{ "type": "array", "items": {} }
```

或 `items` 变成空对象 / 只剩 `properties`，**没有 `type: "array"`**。

Antigravity 的 `Schema.items` 前置校验要求 `$type == Type.ARRAY`，于是报 `field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY`。

这和我之前报的 #3121 / #2784 / #2826 是同一处 `plainSchema` 归一化边界的三种形态：

| Issue | schema 形态 |
|---|---|
| #2784 / #2826 | `type: "array"` 但缺 `items` |
| #3121 | `type: ["string","array"]` 折叠成 `string` 但留着 `items` |
| **本条** | **`items` 是 `oneOf`/`anyOf`，无 `type`** |

## 受影响范围

同一会话 309 个工具里，**32 个**含 `items` 联合类型：

```
mcp__rea__build_call_path
mcp__rea__build_reconstruction_obligation_ledger
mcp__rea__capture_browser_scenario
mcp__rea__capture_electron_scenario
mcp__rea__capture_native_ui_scenario
mcp__rea__compare_application_versions
mcp__rea__compare_artifacts
mcp__rea__compare_bundles
mcp__rea__compare_functions
mcp__rea__correlate_static_and_runtime
mcp__rea__find_changed_behavior
mcp__rea__import_managed_reconstruction
mcp__rea__project_android_application_graph
mcp__rea__project_apple_application_graph
mcp__rea__project_harmony_application_graph
mcp__rea__reconcile_javascript_runtime
mcp__rea__trace_application_feature
mcp__rea__verify_managed_native_reconstruction
mcp__rea__verify_reconstruction
mcp__rea__verify_managed_native_boundaries
... （共 32 个）
```

## 建议修复

在 `plainSchema()` 里补一条 `items` 兜底：**`items` 裁完 `oneOf` / `anyOf` 后若没有 `type`，就按第一个分支的 `type` 补上；若所有分支都是 `object`，就取 `{ "type": "object" }`；否则退化为 `{ "type": "string" }`。**

和 #2826 提的 `ensureArrayItems` 可以合并成一次遍历：

```go
// 伪代码
if node["type"] == "array" {
    it := node["items"]
    if it == nil || it["type"] == nil {
        // 从 oneOf/anyOf 的第一支取 type，取不到就 string
        node["items"] = map[string]any{"type": inferType(it)}
    }
}
```

## 附带发现（和 #2784 评论同一个问题）

这个 400 出现时，magpie **没有**把请求交给路由组的下一个成员，整个回合直接断了。

- 路由组：`group/vibe-coding`
- 13 条失败路由全部 `antigravity/gemini-3.8-flash`，全部 400，全部 0 token 计费
- 每一次都是 `handed_on: false`

`order` 路由下 400 应该算可 fallback 的错误，但它被当成终止性错误了。

## 临时规避

在 DSH / Codex 侧对 Antigravity 禁用含联合类型 schema 的 MCP server，或把 Antigravity 从路由组里摘掉。

comments.body:
补充说明：上游是 REA（`mcp__rea__*`，309 个工具），REA 侧已有相关跟踪。

## 与 REA 侧 Issue 的关系

REA 仓库（`morluto/rea`）已有同族问题的跟踪：

- **#5201** — Gemini 拒绝整个工具目录：`trace_application_feature.seed.value` 的空字符串 `const` 序列化成空 enum 成员
- **#4620** — Gemini CLI 用 REA 报 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT
- **#3806**（PR）— `fix(mcp): make compact schemas gateway compatible`，处理 `oneOf`/`allOf` 嵌套在 required 属性下的情况
- **#5067** — 文档：区分 schema 拒绝与 MCP 配置问题

但 **#5201 的触发点是 `enum: [""]`（空 enum 成员）**，与本条报的 `items` 为 `oneOf`/`anyOf` 且无 `type` **不是同一个触发点**。REA 6.7.0 修完 boolean-`const` 家族后，本条是另一个仍然存在的残留触发点。

## 为什么同时提到 magpie

两条路都能修，作用面不同：

| 位置 | 修什么 | 覆盖面 |
|---|---|---|
| **REA** | 工具 schema 不用 `oneOf`/`anyOf` 表达联合类型 | 只修 REA |
| **magpie**（本条） | `plainSchema()` 给 `items` 补 `type` 兜底 | **修一次，所有 MCP 都受益** |

同一份 REA 工具集走 DeepSeek / GPT / Grok 全部正常，只有 Antigravity 400 —— 说明这是转发层对 Gemini 的适配缺口，不是 REA 的 schema 非法（`oneOf` 是标准 JSON Schema）。

## 已尝试的规避

设置了 `REA_MCP_INPUT_SCHEMA_PROFILE=compact`，未解决。REA 侧 #5067 的 PR 描述也明确写了该 profile「does not narrow the tool count and cannot guarantee API acceptance」，与本条观察一致。

# gateway/antigravity: a tool schema's `items` left on a type that folds off array reaches Gemini and the turn dies with `$type == Type.ARRAY` (#3173)

## Summary

Reported in #3173: a Codex → magpie → Antigravity (`gemini-3.8-flash`) turn fails before generation, deterministically, whenever a tool's parameter schema carries an `items` Antigravity won't take. The upstream's 400, word for word:

```text
400: Antigravity: * GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[67].parameters.properties[functions].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[68].parameters.properties[reviewed_obligations].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
...
```

20+ properties in one turn fail the same predicate; the same tool set through the OpenAI-compatible and DeepSeek routes is fine. The reporter's minimal forms put a bare `oneOf`/`anyOf` (no `type`) on `items`.

## Cause

`plainSchema` (`internal/gateway/codeassist.go:638`) cuts a tool schema down to Antigravity's OpenAPI-style subset. Its walk already folds a union to its first member that isn't null (`codeassist.go:699`) — I verified at base `f5b01574` that the reporter's minimal union-on-`items` shapes come out typed, no union key left. What the walk does not survive is the list form of `type`: it folds `type` to its first non-null entry (`codeassist.go:743`) but copies `items` along regardless, so a parameter declared `["string","array"]` reaches Antigravity as a **string still wearing `items`** — exactly the node the `$type == Type.ARRAY` predicate rejects. Nested under an array property the failing node is named twice over, `items.items`, which is the path in the reporter's 400. #3121 is the one-level form of the same leak, still open. The reporter's real REA schemas are abridged in the issue, so their exact entry shape can't be confirmed; what is confirmed is that this is the one `items`-bearing node `plainSchema` can still emit on a non-array type, and its predicate failure reproduces the report's signature.

## Fix

One rule at the spot every branch of the walk funnels through (`codeassist.go:797`): after type inference, if a node carries `items` and its type isn't `array`, the `items` is stray — drop it. A typeless node that has only `items` still infers `array` first and keeps it, so nothing that was legal is touched. The alternative — preferring `array` when folding a `type` list that contains it — would change what the model is told (array instead of string) and re-litigate the fold's first-member choice; dropping a keyword the folded type can't carry is strictly subtractive and is the same direction the cut-down function already takes everywhere else.

## Verification

| Check | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Red without the fix, base `f5b01574` | `go test ./internal/gateway/ -run TestPlainSchemaDropsItemsOffAnArray -count=1 -v` | FAIL, stray `items` in `got` |
| Green with the fix | `go test ./internal/gateway/ -run TestPlainSchema -count=1 -v` | 3/3 PASS (existing, new red, union guard) |
| Union-on-`items` guard (reporter's minimal forms) | same run, `TestPlainSchemaFoldsAUnionOnItems` | PASS at base and with the fix |
| Race | `go test -race ./internal/gateway/ -run TestPlainSchema -count=1` | ok |
| Vet / fmt | `go vet ./internal/gateway/`; `gofmt -l` on touched files | clean, no output |
| Builds | `go build ./...` darwin/arm64; `GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -tags nogui ./...`; `GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -tags nogui ./...` | all ok |
| Package | `go test ./internal/gateway/ -p 1 -timeout 30m -count=1` | ok (329.97s) |
| Degenerate inputs | `oneOf: []`, non-array `oneOf`, boolean/`null`/empty-object `items`, garbage `type`, malformed JSON | no panic; stray items dropped; malformed JSON returned unchanged |

## Not verified

- No end-to-end turn against a real Antigravity account — the verification above is schema-level, through `plainSchema` and the gateway package.
- The reporter's full REA tool set (309 tools, 32 affected) is not public in the issue, so the exact schemas that entered the failing request were not replayed; the repro uses the 400's path shape (`items.items`) and the reporter's abridged JSON.

---

**Source**: reported in #3173 (huaiqing-afk, with the upstream's 400 word for word).

**Red without the fix** (base `f5b01574`):

```text
=== RUN   TestPlainSchemaDropsItemsOffAnArray
    plain_schema_test.go:63: got {"properties":{"actions":{"items":{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"string"},"type":"array"},"disease":{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"type":"string"},"functions":{"items":{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}},"required":["disease"],"type":"object"}
--- FAIL: TestPlainSchemaDropsItemsOffAnArray (0.00s)
```

The inner node `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"string"}` is a string wearing `items` — the node Gemini's `$type == Type.ARRAY` predicate rejects, and `functions` wraps it in an array, giving the reported two-level `items.items` path.

**Siblings**: #3121 (open) is the same leak one level up, `properties[disease].items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY`; this patch covers it and says so in the code comment. #2784 and #2826 (both open) are the other half — an array with **no** `items` at all, rejected with a different predicate ("missing field"); fixing that means *adding* an `items`, which this patch deliberately does not do.

**When the read fails**: the 400 is quoted in full in #3173's opening post and again in the Summary here; the reporter's abridged schemas are in the same post. If the branch link below rots, the patch at the bottom applies to `f5b01574` of yetone/magpie with `git am`.

**Not verified**: end-to-end against a real Antigravity account; a replay of the reporter's 309-tool REA set.

Branch with the commit: [hunt57-b-antigravity-items](https://github.com/ggbdpq/magpie/tree/hunt57-b-antigravity-items) (head `b7a4095176e1501a8f24931f26de63cecebff810`).

**Attribution**: AI-written; an AI coding agent read the issue, reproduced the failure as a test against base `f5b01574`, and verified the fix per the table above. The patch is committed locally as `ggbdpq <ggbdpq@gmail.com>` and is not pushed.

**Patch**: SHA-256 first 16 `450898304acc4437`

```patch
From b7a4095176e1501a8f24931f26de63cecebff810 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: ggbdpq <ggbdpq@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 20:40:29 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] gateway: a type that folds off array leaves a tool schema's
 items behind, so Antigravity takes the turn (#3173)
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

plainSchema folds a schema's list of types to its first one that isn't
null but carried the items keyword along: a tool whose parameter said
["string","array"] reached Antigravity as a string still wearing items,
and Gemini's check that items rides on an array turned the whole turn
away with "field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY" — under an
array property that failure names the node twice over, items.items.
#3121 is the one-level form of the same leak. A union on items folds to
its first member already; what leaked was the keyword a non-array type
had no business carrying. plainSchema now drops items wherever the type
it survives with isn't array — the one spot every branch of the walk
(refs, allOf, unions, plain nodes) funnels through.

What changed
- internal/gateway/codeassist.go: plainSchema deletes items off a node
  whose folded type isn't array.
- internal/gateway/plain_schema_test.go: a schema of #3173's reported
  shape — items over items under an array, the type list folding to
  string — comes out with no stray items; unions on items, #3173's
  minimal forms, are pinned folding to their first member.

Run
- go test ./internal/gateway/ -run TestPlainSchema -count=1 -v: 3/3,
  red at base f5b01574 before the fix
- go test -race ./internal/gateway/ -run TestPlainSchema -count=1
- go vet ./internal/gateway/, gofmt clean
- go build ./... on darwin/arm64; GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 and
  GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64, both -tags nogui
- go test ./internal/gateway/ -p 1 -timeout 30m

Fixes #3173

 2 files changed, 59 insertions(+)

diff --git a/internal/gateway/codeassist.go b/internal/gateway/codeassist.go
index 82a77969..43fd993a 100644
--- a/internal/gateway/codeassist.go
+++ b/internal/gateway/codeassist.go
@@ -794,6 +794,13 @@ func plainSchema(raw json.RawMessage) json.RawMessage {
 					out["type"] = "array"
 				}
 			}
+			if out["items"] != nil && out["type"] != "array" {
+				// items rides on an array only: a type that folds to
+				// something else, as ["string","array"] does to string,
+				// leaves it stray and Antigravity turns the turn away
+				// over it (#3121, #3173)
+				delete(out, "items")

 }

+// else, as ["string","array"] does to string, has to leave it behind or the
+// schema reaches Gemini with an items on a string and the turn is turned
+// away with "field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY" (#3121, #3173).
+func TestPlainSchemaDropsItemsOffAnArray(t *testing.T) {
+	in := `{"type":"object","properties":{

+		"functions":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"items":{"type":["string","array"],"items":{"type":"string"}}},

+}

+// a union folds to its first member that isn't null, on items as anywhere
+// else (#3173): items under a oneOf come out as that member, typed.
+func TestPlainSchemaFoldsAUnionOnItems(t *testing.T) {

+		"actions":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"kind":{"type":"string"}},"required":["kind"]}},
+		"subject":{"type":"object","properties":{"path":{"type":"string"}}},
```

补充 #3121 下修复与本条的关系：[skygunner/magpie 的 c638203e](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/c638203ee99232910d6d3d989d44791ba4128692)（分支 `fix/union-items`，基于 `87d703c5`）也处理了嵌套 `items.items` 上的同类非法 schema。@ggbdpq 已在 [#3121 的验证回复](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/3121#issuecomment-6345136723) 比较过两种补丁。

修复在 `plainSchema` 的递归归一化出口统一做：节点带 `items` / `minItems` / `maxItems`，原 `type` 列表又包含 `array` 时保留数组那一支；没有数组分支时清除不适用于当前类型的数组关键字。外层或嵌套在 `items` / `oneOf` 内都会经过这一处，因此不会再生成带 `items` 的 `type: "string"`。

这次用隔离 HOME、Go 1.26.8、umask 022 重新验证：

- fork 上 `go test -tags nogui -count=1 -timeout 5m -run 'TestPlainSchema|TestAudit3173' ./internal/gateway` 通过；`TestAudit3173*` 是本次临时审阅测试，没有提交到分支。
- 保留测试，换成最新上游 `ca4a1cde` 的 `codeassist.go`：现有 `TestPlainSchemaUnionBesideItemsKeepsTheArrayHalf` 与新增的嵌套 type-list 用例都失败，后者报 `items on non-array`；恢复修复后通过。
- 单纯的 `items.oneOf` 最小形式在修改前后都能正确折叠成带类型的节点。因此不能把它单独当作这次修复的复现用例。

限制需要说明：原帖的完整 309 个工具 schema 没有公开，示例含 `...`，因此上述验证覆盖与错误路径相同的嵌套形态，不能声称已重放原始 32 个 schema 或真实 Antigravity 回合。原帖另提的 400 是否继续 fallback，这个补丁也没有改。没有重新运行全量测试或真实供应商请求；原提交 body 中保留的是当时的验证记录。

补充说明：上游是 REA（`mcp__rea__*`，309 个工具），REA 侧已有相关跟踪。

## 与 REA 侧 Issue 的关系

REA 仓库（`morluto/rea`）已有同族问题的跟踪：

- **#5201** — Gemini 拒绝整个工具目录：`trace_application_feature.seed.value` 的空字符串 `const` 序列化成空 enum 成员
- **#4620** — Gemini CLI 用 REA 报 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT
- **#3806**（PR）— `fix(mcp): make compact schemas gateway compatible`，处理 `oneOf`/`allOf` 嵌套在 required 属性下的情况
- **#5067** — 文档：区分 schema 拒绝与 MCP 配置问题

但 **#5201 的触发点是 `enum: [""]`（空 enum 成员）**，与本条报的 `items` 为 `oneOf`/`anyOf` 且无 `type` **不是同一个触发点**。REA 6.7.0 修完 boolean-`const` 家族后，本条是另一个仍然存在的残留触发点。

## 为什么同时提到 magpie

两条路都能修，作用面不同：

| 位置 | 修什么 | 覆盖面 |
|---|---|---|
| **REA** | 工具 schema 不用 `oneOf`/`anyOf` 表达联合类型 | 只修 REA |
| **magpie**（本条） | `plainSchema()` 给 `items` 补 `type` 兜底 | **修一次，所有 MCP 都受益** |

同一份 REA 工具集走 DeepSeek / GPT / Grok 全部正常，只有 Antigravity 400 —— 说明这是转发层对 Gemini 的适配缺口，不是 REA 的 schema 非法（`oneOf` 是标准 JSON Schema）。

## 已尝试的规避

设置了 `REA_MCP_INPUT_SCHEMA_PROFILE=compact`，未解决。REA 侧 #5067 的 PR 描述也明确写了该 profile「does not narrow the tool count and cannot guarantee API acceptance」，与本条观察一致。

issue.title: [Bug] Gemini-backed clients still reject the whole tool catalog: advertised empty-string const in trace_application_feature.seed.value serializes as an empty enum member

repository.name: rea
repository.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.

issue.body:
### Summary

REA 6.7.0 fixed the boolean-`const` family (#4025, a2e30168a), and a `tools/list` scan now shows 0 non-string `const`/`enum` — but one advertised **empty-string** `const` remains, and it still makes every Gemini request fail. Clients that render `const` as a one-member `enum` produce `enum: [""]`, and Google rejects empty enum members with `enum[0]: cannot be empty`. This issue isolates the exact remaining trigger behind the user-facing report in #4620.

### Environment

| | |
|---|---|
| rea-agents | `6.7.0` (npm latest; also present on `main`) |
| Node | `24.22.0` |
| Client | opencode `1.18.32`, Google Gemini provider (every Gemini model) |
| Transport | MCP stdio, `npx -y rea-agents@6.7.0 mcp` |

### Observed error

```
GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[243].parameters.properties[seed].any_of[1].properties[value].enum[0]: cannot be empty
GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[243].parameters.properties[seed].any_of[2].any_of[1].properties[value].enum[0]: cannot be empty
GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[243].parameters.properties[seed].any_of[3].any_of[1].properties[value].enum[0]: cannot be empty
```

### Where the value is advertised (observed)

Method: MCP stdio handshake (`initialize` -> `notifications/initialized` -> `tools/list`), then a recursive walk of every `inputSchema` collecting non-string **and** empty-string `const`/`enum` values. On `rea-agents@6.7.0`: 207 tools, exactly **1 tool affected, 3 occurrences** (none in any other tool; same result in the `compact` profile):

| tool | path |
|---|---|
| `trace_application_feature` | `properties.seed.anyOf[1].properties.value.const = ""` |
| `trace_application_feature` | `properties.seed.anyOf[2].anyOf[1].properties.value.const = ""` |
| `trace_application_feature` | `properties.seed.anyOf[3].anyOf[1].properties.value.const = ""` |

This matches the failing declaration's `seed -> any_of[1/2/3] -> value -> enum[0]` path exactly. Non-string consts/enums: none in either profile (the #4025 fix holds).

### Why it fails

Source-derived: the canonical schema selects branch variants with `z.literal("")` (exact empty route/string value); the advertised projection keeps `const: ""`; the client's declaration rendering maps `const` to a one-member `enum`; Google requires enum members to be non-empty strings, so the whole catalog is rejected.

### Expected / suggestion

Extend the literal presentation added for #4025 to empty-string literals: advertise the field as `type: "string"` (keeping `default`/`description`) instead of `const: ""`, and relax affected `oneOf` groups to `anyOf` where the widened literal distinguished overlapping branches (same rationale as a2e30168a). Canonical Zod validation stays unchanged. A catalog-wide test can assert no non-string and no empty-string `const`/`enum` in either profile.

Happy to open a PR for this.

### Related

#4025 (boolean const family; fixed in a2e30168a), #4620 (Gemini CLI user report), #5067 (docs diagnostic proposal).

# gateway/antigravity: a tool schema's `items` left on a type that folds off array reaches Gemini and the turn dies with `$type == Type.ARRAY` (#3173)

## Summary

Reported in #3173: a Codex → magpie → Antigravity (`gemini-3.8-flash`) turn fails before generation, deterministically, whenever a tool's parameter schema carries an `items` Antigravity won't take. The upstream's 400, word for word:

```text
400: Antigravity: * GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[67].parameters.properties[functions].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[68].parameters.properties[reviewed_obligations].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
...
```

20+ properties in one turn fail the same predicate; the same tool set through the OpenAI-compatible and DeepSeek routes is fine. The reporter's minimal forms put a bare `oneOf`/`anyOf` (no `type`) on `items`.

## Cause

`plainSchema` (`internal/gateway/codeassist.go:638`) cuts a tool schema down to Antigravity's OpenAPI-style subset. Its walk already folds a union to its first member that isn't null (`codeassist.go:699`) — I verified at base `f5b01574` that the reporter's minimal union-on-`items` shapes come out typed, no union key left. What the walk does not survive is the list form of `type`: it folds `type` to its first non-null entry (`codeassist.go:743`) but copies `items` along regardless, so a parameter declared `["string","array"]` reaches Antigravity as a **string still wearing `items`** — exactly the node the `$type == Type.ARRAY` predicate rejects. Nested under an array property the failing node is named twice over, `items.items`, which is the path in the reporter's 400. #3121 is the one-level form of the same leak, still open. The reporter's real REA schemas are abridged in the issue, so their exact entry shape can't be confirmed; what is confirmed is that this is the one `items`-bearing node `plainSchema` can still emit on a non-array type, and its predicate failure reproduces the report's signature.

## Fix

One rule at the spot every branch of the walk funnels through (`codeassist.go:797`): after type inference, if a node carries `items` and its type isn't `array`, the `items` is stray — drop it. A typeless node that has only `items` still infers `array` first and keeps it, so nothing that was legal is touched. The alternative — preferring `array` when folding a `type` list that contains it — would change what the model is told (array instead of string) and re-litigate the fold's first-member choice; dropping a keyword the folded type can't carry is strictly subtractive and is the same direction the cut-down function already takes everywhere else.

## Verification

| Check | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Red without the fix, base `f5b01574` | `go test ./internal/gateway/ -run TestPlainSchemaDropsItemsOffAnArray -count=1 -v` | FAIL, stray `items` in `got` |
| Green with the fix | `go test ./internal/gateway/ -run TestPlainSchema -count=1 -v` | 3/3 PASS (existing, new red, union guard) |
| Union-on-`items` guard (reporter's minimal forms) | same run, `TestPlainSchemaFoldsAUnionOnItems` | PASS at base and with the fix |
| Race | `go test -race ./internal/gateway/ -run TestPlainSchema -count=1` | ok |
| Vet / fmt | `go vet ./internal/gateway/`; `gofmt -l` on touched files | clean, no output |
| Builds | `go build ./...` darwin/arm64; `GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -tags nogui ./...`; `GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -tags nogui ./...` | all ok |
| Package | `go test ./internal/gateway/ -p 1 -timeout 30m -count=1` | ok (329.97s) |
| Degenerate inputs | `oneOf: []`, non-array `oneOf`, boolean/`null`/empty-object `items`, garbage `type`, malformed JSON | no panic; stray items dropped; malformed JSON returned unchanged |

## Not verified

- No end-to-end turn against a real Antigravity account — the verification above is schema-level, through `plainSchema` and the gateway package.
- The reporter's full REA tool set (309 tools, 32 affected) is not public in the issue, so the exact schemas that entered the failing request were not replayed; the repro uses the 400's path shape (`items.items`) and the reporter's abridged JSON.

---

**Source**: reported in #3173 (huaiqing-afk, with the upstream's 400 word for word).

**Red without the fix** (base `f5b01574`):

```text
=== RUN   TestPlainSchemaDropsItemsOffAnArray
    plain_schema_test.go:63: got {"properties":{"actions":{"items":{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"string"},"type":"array"},"disease":{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"type":"string"},"functions":{"items":{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}},"required":["disease"],"type":"object"}
--- FAIL: TestPlainSchemaDropsItemsOffAnArray (0.00s)
```

The inner node `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"string"}` is a string wearing `items` — the node Gemini's `$type == Type.ARRAY` predicate rejects, and `functions` wraps it in an array, giving the reported two-level `items.items` path.

**Siblings**: #3121 (open) is the same leak one level up, `properties[disease].items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY`; this patch covers it and says so in the code comment. #2784 and #2826 (both open) are the other half — an array with **no** `items` at all, rejected with a different predicate ("missing field"); fixing that means *adding* an `items`, which this patch deliberately does not do.

**When the read fails**: the 400 is quoted in full in #3173's opening post and again in the Summary here; the reporter's abridged schemas are in the same post. If the branch link below rots, the patch at the bottom applies to `f5b01574` of yetone/magpie with `git am`.

**Not verified**: end-to-end against a real Antigravity account; a replay of the reporter's 309-tool REA set.

Branch with the commit: [hunt57-b-antigravity-items](https://github.com/ggbdpq/magpie/tree/hunt57-b-antigravity-items) (head `b7a4095176e1501a8f24931f26de63cecebff810`).

**Attribution**: AI-written; an AI coding agent read the issue, reproduced the failure as a test against base `f5b01574`, and verified the fix per the table above. The patch is committed locally as `ggbdpq <ggbdpq@gmail.com>` and is not pushed.

**Patch**: SHA-256 first 16 `450898304acc4437`

```patch
 items behind, so Antigravity takes the turn (#3173)
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

plainSchema folds a schema's list of types to its first one that isn't

and Gemini's check that items rides on an array turned the whole turn
```

issue.title: gateway/antigravity: union type ["string","array"] keeps items but collapses to string — Gemini 400 on tool schema

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## Summary

A Codex Desktop conversation routed through magpie to an Antigravity account fails before generation when an MCP tool declares a parameter as a JSON Schema type **union** that combines `string` and `array` while also defining `items`.

Observed error:

```text
Antigravity: * GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[23].parameters.properties[disease].items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[23].parameters.properties[drug].items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
```

HTTP 400, deterministic on every turn that includes the tool. The same tool set works fine through OpenAI-compatible providers on the same gateway.

## Environment

- Client: Codex Desktop, agent `codex@wsl:Ubuntu-22.04`
- Route: Codex → magpie gateway → Antigravity subscription (`gemini-3.8-flash`)
- magpie: `0.1.1306` (Windows)
- Observed: 2026-10-21
- MCP server: `biomcp` 0.9.3 (`biomcp serve`), tool `search`

## Minimal schema shape

The `search` tool declares `disease` and `drug` as:

```json
{
  "disease": {
    "type": ["string", "array"],
    "items": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 256 },
    "minItems": 1,
    "maxItems": 3,
    "minLength": 1,
    "maxLength": 256,
    "uniqueItems": true
  }
}
```

This is valid JSON Schema: the parameter accepts either a single string or an array of strings.

## Root cause

`plainSchema()` in `internal/gateway/codeassist.go` folds the `type` list like this:

```go
case "type":
    if ts, ok := v.([]any); ok {
        for _, t := range ts {
            if t == "null" {
                out["nullable"] = true
            } else if out["type"] == nil {
                out["type"] = t
            }
        }
    }
```

The first non-`null` member wins, so `["string", "array"]` collapses to `type: "string"`. Meanwhile `case "items"` copies `items` through verbatim. The emitted schema is:

```json
{ "type": "string", "items": { ... }, "minItems": 1, "maxItems": 3, "uniqueItems": true }
```

`uniqueItems` is dropped (outside the subset), but `items`, `minItems`, and `maxItems` all survive on a non-array type — and Antigravity's `Schema.items` predicate requires `$type == Type.ARRAY`, hence the 400.

This is the mirror image of #2784 / #2826 (array schemas missing `items`); here it is `items` surviving on a non-array type.

## Proposed fix

When `type` is a list, pick the member consistent with the schema's sibling keywords rather than blindly taking the first non-null entry. Minimal rule covering this case: if `x["items"] != nil` (or `minItems` / `maxItems` / `uniqueItems` present) and the list contains `"array"`, select `"array"`. Symmetrically, if the chosen type ends up non-array, drop `items`/`minItems`/`maxItems`/`uniqueItems` so the emitted schema stays self-consistent — Gemini validates `items` only against `type`, so either choice unblocks the request.

timeline.body: Thanks @ggbdpq for the thorough investigation, test cases, and fix patch! Closing as resolved.

issue.title: gateway: nested array tool schema without items makes Antigravity reject every turn with 400

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## Summary

A Claude Code conversation routed through magpie to an Antigravity account fails before generation when two tool declarations contain a nested array whose inner array schema has no `items`.

Observed error:

```text
API Error: 400 Antigravity: * GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[1].parameters.properties[query].properties[where].items.items: missing field.
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[3].parameters.properties[query].properties[where].items.items: missing field.
```

This is not a transient account/quota failure. Retrying the turn sends the same invalid function declarations and fails again.

## Environment

- Client: Claude Code
- Route: Claude Code → magpie gateway → Antigravity subscription
- Observed: 2026-10-18
- Current source inspected: `main` at `d783df46cbac9021e26a6bd71ca0b55544552eb2`
- Exact installed magpie version was not visible in the captured error

## Minimal schema shape

The failing path corresponds to a schema like:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "query": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "where": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "array"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

The outer `where` array has an `items` schema, but that item is itself an array with no `items`. JSON Schema clients can use an array without constraining its elements, but Antigravity's function-declaration validator requires an item schema for every array node.

## Root cause

Antigravity declarations are built in `internal/gateway/codeassist.go`:

```go
if ag {
    d["parameters"] = plainSchema(schema)
}
```

`plainSchema` recursively walks `items` when it exists:

```go
case "items":
    out[k] = walk(v, depth+1)
```

and infers `type: "array"` when `items` exists, but it does not repair the inverse case: a node already declaring `type: "array"` with no `items`. Therefore the inner node remains:

```json
{"type":"array"}
```

and reaches Antigravity unchanged, producing the reported `...items.items: missing field` 400.

This is the same normalization boundary involved in #187 / commit `e4375ce9670f983207d36e358f34d916608245b7`, but #187 covered unsupported keywords rather than required fields.

## Expected behavior

The Antigravity translation should never forward an array schema that its upstream validator rejects.

For every normalized node whose final type is `array`:

- preserve and recursively normalize an existing `items`;
- if `items` is absent, supply an Antigravity-compatible permissive item schema (or otherwise degrade that node safely);
- do this at every nesting depth.

The conversation should then reach the model instead of failing the whole turn.

## Suggested regression test

Add a case to `internal/gateway/plain_schema_test.go` with `query.where` as an array of arrays where the inner array omits `items`, and assert that every output array node has a valid item schema.

A `buildCodeAssist(..., "antigravity")` regression would also pin the complete request path and ensure both ordinary and nested arrays produce acceptable `functionDeclarations[].parameters`.

## Duplicate check

I searched open and closed issues for the exact `items.items: missing field` error and for Antigravity array-schema failures; no existing issue covers this case. #187 is related but distinct.

补充 #3121 下修复与本条的关系：[skygunner/magpie 的 c638203e](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/c638203ee99232910d6d3d989d44791ba4128692)（分支 `fix/union-items`，基于 `87d703c5`）也处理了嵌套 `items.items` 上的同类非法 schema。@ggbdpq 已在 [#3121 的验证回复](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/3121#issuecomment-6345136723) 比较过两种补丁。

修复在 `plainSchema` 的递归归一化出口统一做：节点带 `items` / `minItems` / `maxItems`，原 `type` 列表又包含 `array` 时保留数组那一支；没有数组分支时清除不适用于当前类型的数组关键字。外层或嵌套在 `items` / `oneOf` 内都会经过这一处，因此不会再生成带 `items` 的 `type: "string"`。

这次用隔离 HOME、Go 1.26.8、umask 022 重新验证：

- fork 上 `go test -tags nogui -count=1 -timeout 5m -run 'TestPlainSchema|TestAudit3173' ./internal/gateway` 通过；`TestAudit3173*` 是本次临时审阅测试，没有提交到分支。
- 保留测试，换成最新上游 `ca4a1cde` 的 `codeassist.go`：现有 `TestPlainSchemaUnionBesideItemsKeepsTheArrayHalf` 与新增的嵌套 type-list 用例都失败，后者报 `items on non-array`；恢复修复后通过。
- 单纯的 `items.oneOf` 最小形式在修改前后都能正确折叠成带类型的节点。因此不能把它单独当作这次修复的复现用例。

限制需要说明：原帖的完整 309 个工具 schema 没有公开，示例含 `...`，因此上述验证覆盖与错误路径相同的嵌套形态，不能声称已重放原始 32 个 schema 或真实 Antigravity 回合。原帖另提的 400 是否继续 fallback，这个补丁也没有改。没有重新运行全量测试或真实供应商请求；原提交 body 中保留的是当时的验证记录。

issue.title: [Bug] Antigravity 适配层透传 JSON Schema 联合类型 type:["object","array"] + items，Google 严格校验必 400（带最小复现）

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 环境
- magpie `0.1.1323`（macOS 27.0，Apple Silicon，桌面 App + gateway :3425）
- 客户端：Codex CLI（经 Magpie gateway，`group/cap-route` → compact 规则改派 `group/fast`，首跳 `antigravity/gemini-3.8-flash`）
- Antigravity 账号已登录，普通请求一切正常

## 现象（确定性，非偶发）
Codex 的**远端压缩请求（remote compaction）携带工具 schema** 发到 Magpie，经 Antigravity 适配层翻译后，Google 返回 400，整轮作废：

```
Antigravity: * GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[0].parameters.properties[params].items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
```

## 根因
工具的某个参数（本例是 codex_apps 桥接的 MCP 工具，参数名 `params`）用了**合法的 OpenAI/JSON Schema 联合类型**：

```json
{
  "type": ["object", "array"],
  "description": "Tool params as a real JSON object (an array for the handful of array-body tools) ...",
  "items": { "type": "string" },
  "properties": {}
}
```

Magpie 的 Antigravity 适配层（OpenAI→Gemini 翻译）把联合类型**原样透传**了。Google 的 Schema proto 是严格校验：`items` 字段存在时 `type` 必须恰好是 `Type.ARRAY`（单值），联合类型直接判死。

## 最小复现（同通道三发对照，本机实测）

对 `http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1/chat/completions` 发 `model: antigravity/gemini-3.8-flash`，tools 里放一个 function，其 `parameters.properties.params` 分别用三种 schema：

| 实验 | `params` 的 schema | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| A | `{"type":["object","array"],"items":{"type":"string"},"properties":{}}` | **HTTP 400**，报错与线上失败逐字一致 |
| B | `{"type":"object","properties":{}}` | ✅ HTTP 200 |
| C | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}` | ✅ HTTP 200 |

复现脚本（A 例）：

```bash
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1/chat/completions   -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer magpie"   -d '{
    "model": "antigravity/gemini-3.8-flash",
    "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"回复OK"}],
    "max_tokens": 10,
    "tools": [{
      "type": "function",
      "function": {
        "name": "test_tool",
        "description": "probe",
        "parameters": {"type":"object","properties":{"params":{"type":["object","array"],"description":"Tool params","items":{"type":"string"},"properties":{}}},"required":[]}
      }
    }]
  }'
```

同一通道、同一账号：干净 schema 秒过，联合类型必炸 ⇒ 问题在翻译层，不在 Antigravity 账号或网络。

## 影响
- 触发条件隐蔽：只有当请求**带工具**且某工具参数用了联合类型时才 400。日常小请求不带工具，所以看起来"偶发"。
- 杀伤大：Codex remote compaction 请求天然带全套工具 schema，命中即整轮作废（实测一次白跑 2598 秒）。路由日志一天 274 条 compact 里 124 条带 tools，只要这批工具里有联合类型参数就可能炸。
- 其他 Gemini 系 provider 若走同一翻译层，可能同样受影响。

## 期望修复
翻译为 Gemini Schema 时做一次规范化（normalization），例如：
- 联合类型 `["object","array"]` → 取第一个非 array 类型（`object`），或拆成 `anyOf` 前先剥掉 Google 不认的字段；
- `items` 仅在 `type == "array"`（单值）时保留，否则丢弃；
- 顺带可考虑 `additionalProperties` / `anyOf` 等 Google proto 不支持字段的通用降级。

## 规避（临时）
路由组里把 `antigravity/*` 从会接收带工具请求的组（如 compact 改派目标 `group/fast`）的**首位**挪走，让带工具的请求首跳到能正确翻译的 provider。
